_about: Per-parish registry of public ArcGIS REST layers, by role. 'authority' is who maintains the copy: parish (the parish or its assessor), municipal, consultant-copy (an engineering firm's snapshot, often years old), unofficial (no stated provenance). field_map maps canonical names to layer fields; a list means OR/coalesce across fields. Verified 2026-10-16 unless status says otherwise.

st-charles.name: St. Charles Parish
st-charles.assessor_note: St. Charles Assessor: stcharlesassessor.com. The parish GIS layer carries owner and assessed value directly.

owner_fallback.note: AGOL copy, about 2021. Owner differs from the parish layer on roughly 20% of matched parcels. Not queried automatically; check it by hand only if maps.scpgis.com is down, and label any owner from it as 2021.

zoning.label: St. Charles Parish zoning
zoning.note: The parcel layer's own 'zoning' attribute is often blank or stale; this polygon layer is the zoning of record in the parish viewer.

structures.label: SCP building footprints
structures.residential_where: Shape__Area < 6000 AND (owner_name IS NULL OR NOT (owner_name LIKE '%EXEMP%' AND owner_name NOT LIKE '%HOUS%' AND (owner_name LIKE '%PORT OF%' OR owner_name LIKE '%SCHOOL%' OR owner_name LIKE '%FIRE DEP%' OR owner_name LIKE '%VOL. FIRE%' OR owner_name LIKE '%DRAINAGE%' OR owner_name LIKE '%WW DIST%' OR owner_name LIKE '%HWYS%' OR owner_name LIKE '%CEME%' OR owner_name LIKE '%PARISH LAW%' OR owner_name LIKE '%HOSP%' OR owner_name LIKE '%STATE OF LOUISIANA%' OR owner_name LIKE '%CITY OF NEW ORLEANS%' OR owner_name LIKE 'ST. CHARLES PARISH %')))
structures.residential_basis: SCP publishes no building-use code. 'Likely dwelling' = a non-demolished footprint under 6,000 sq ft; industrial and commercial buildings above that size fall in 'other'. Tax-exempt public owners (parish government, school board, port, fire, drainage, highways, hospital, cemeteries) and the footprint's own owner are excluded; exempt housing authorities, churches (parsonages) and individuals stay in. Expect some sheds, garages and small commercial buildings in the likely-dwelling count.

ascension.name: Ascension Parish
ascension.assessor_note: Schneider Beacon returns 403 to scripts (Cloudflare). Open the link in a real browser to confirm the current owner of the project parcel.

parcels.note: Current parish parcel geometry. Carries the parcel number only; owner comes from an owner source below.

owner_sources.note: Parish ArcGIS Server. Was returning 'Could not access any server machines' on 2026-10-16; tried first in case it is back. Field names unverified, so attributes are returned raw.

owner_sources.stale: Westwood consultant copy; LAST_REVIS max 2016-02. Owner may have changed since.

owner_other_copies: Parish market-area extracts All_Parcels_5/7 and MA_8/9/10 (2018, partial coverage)

zoning.label: Ascension Parish zoning districts
zoning.note: 'R' is Rural, which permits single-family homes; MU (mixed-use corridor) and A also permit dwellings but are not counted as residential here. CIT/CITY = incorporated territory (Gonzales, Donaldsonville, Sorrento), zoned by the municipality.

structures.label: Ascension address points
structures.residential_where: USETYPE IN ('R','Residential House','Residential MF Condo','Residential Mobile Home','Residential MF TH','Trailer /RV Park')
structures.residential_basis: Address points with a residential USETYPE. About a quarter of points have no USETYPE; they are counted under 'other/unclassified', so the residential count is a floor.

st-james.name: St. James Parish
st-james.assessor_note: St. James Assessor data is published directly in the parish GIS (AssInfo).

owner_fallback.note: Mirror of AssInfo/3 on the same server.

zoning.label: St. James land-use map (AGOL user josh_lld, no stated provenance)
zoning.note: Appears to digitize the parish land-use plan. Not zoning, not adopted-ordinance text; cite the parish's own land-use plan instead.

st-james.zoning_gap: St. James Parish publishes no parish zoning layer. Outside Gramercy, zoning cannot be read from GIS; ask the Planning Department or file a records request for the land-use ordinance map.

structures.label: St. James assessor building footprints
structures.residential_basis: Assessor ClassCode: 4000 single-family, 4010 manufactured, 4020 townhouse/duplex, 4030 row house, 4040 multi-family, 4060 cottage/cabin, 4080 camp, 4090 historic residence. Records with Status 3 (Delete) are dropped.

east-baton-rouge.name: East Baton Rouge Parish
east-baton-rouge.hint: City-Parish open data (data.brla.gov) and maps.brla.gov publish tax parcels and zoning.
